_notes: CMS/AMA 2021+ Office/Outpatient E/M (99202-99215) selection criteria. Educational reference structure only — verify against current CMS/AMA source documents before production/compliance use.

straightforward.label: 1 self-limited or minor problem
examples: single self-limited problem
minor injury with expected quick resolution

low.label: 2+ self-limited/minor problems, OR 1 stable chronic illness, OR 1 acute uncomplicated illness/injury
examples: two minor complaints same visit
one stable chronic condition, no changes
uncomplicated acute illness (e.g. simple UTI)

moderate.label: 1+ chronic illness with exacerbation/progression/treatment side effects, OR 2+ stable chronic illnesses, OR 1 undiagnosed new problem with uncertain prognosis, OR 1 acute illness with systemic symptoms, OR 1 acute complicated injury
examples: diabetes with worsening control
two or more stable chronic conditions managed together
new symptom needing workup, cause unclear
acute illness with systemic signs (fever, malaise)

high.label: 1+ chronic illness with severe exacerbation/progression/side effects, OR acute/chronic illness or injury posing a threat to life or bodily function
examples: severe exacerbation of chronic disease
condition threatening limb, organ, or life

minimal.label: None or minimal data reviewed
examples: no tests ordered or reviewed

categories.category1_testsAndDocuments: Review of prior external note(s) from each unique source, and/or review of each unique test result, and/or ordering of each unique test (any combination counts toward a total of 2)
categories.category2_independentHistorian: Assessment requiring an independent historian (e.g. family member, caregiver) because patient can't provide reliable history

categories.category1_testsDocsHistorian: Any combination of 3 from: unique test ordered, unique test reviewed, unique prior note reviewed, independent historian
categories.category2_independentInterpretation: Independent interpretation of a test performed by another physician/QHP (not separately billed)
categories.category3_discussion: Discussion of management or test interpretation with an external physician/QHP/appropriate source

categories.category1_testsDocsHistorian: Any combination of 3 from: unique test ordered, unique test reviewed, unique prior note reviewed, independent historian
categories.category2_independentInterpretation: Independent interpretation of a test performed by another physician/QHP (not separately billed)
categories.category3_discussion: Discussion of management or test interpretation with an external physician/QHP/appropriate source

minimal.label: Minimal risk of morbidity
examples: no treatment
rest, reassurance

low.label: Low risk of morbidity
examples: over-the-counter medication management
minor procedure with no identified risk factors

moderate.label: Moderate risk of morbidity
examples: prescription drug management
minor surgery with identified patient/procedure risk factors
social determinants of health significantly limiting diagnosis or treatment

high.label: High risk of morbidity
examples: drug therapy requiring intensive monitoring for toxicity
decision regarding elective major surgery with risk factors
decision regarding emergency major surgery
decision regarding hospitalization
decision not to resuscitate or to de-escalate care given poor prognosis
